question: Who among the following was the founder of the Khudai Khidmatgars, a powerful non violent movement among the Pathans of North-West Frontier Province?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan** was the founder of the Khudai Khidmatgars, a powerful non-violent movement among the Pathans of North-West Frontier Province.
 
• Also known as the "Frontier Gandhi," he was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement.
